newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as cash weakens, harvest.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as cash weakens, harvest.

text.p: Weaker tones in the cash markets and aggressive harvesting of the U.S. rice crop pressured CBOT rice futures to a lower close, traders said.
"The market is beginning to sense there's a big crop being harvested," a trader said.
Traders also said only routine export demand plus "very little activity in the Thai market" also pressured prices.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 600 contracts, up from 213 Wednesday, according to the CBOT. Rice options volume was estimated at 50 contracts, up from five Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed 18-1/2 to 21 cents per cwt lower with September down 18-1/2 at $10.06-1/2 per cwt.
